Strategy: Give a bonus to bins in the loosest quarter of feasible residuals, measured from the current minimum to maximum, so very loose bins are used before mid-range ones. It may help by spending the loosest capacity first, but may fail by wasting bins that could fit large future items.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r >= min(bins) + 3 * (max(bins) - min(bins)) / 4 else 0) for r in bins]
```
